title: Search Suggestions System
key_insight: 排序后对每个前缀用二分查找找到起始位置，取最多3个结果
approach: 排序+二分查找，或用Trie树
code_python3:
import bisect
class Solution:
    def suggestedProducts(self, products, searchWord):
        products.sort()
        res, prefix, start = [], '', 0
        for c in searchWord:
            prefix += c
            start = bisect.bisect_left(products, prefix, start)
            suggestions = [products[i] for i in range(start, min(start+3, len(products))) if products[i].startswith(prefix)]
            res.append(suggestions)
        return res

title: Number of Ways to Stay in the Same Place After Some Steps
key_insight: DP[step][pos]表示走step步在pos位置的方案数，位置范围限制为min(steps//2+1, arrLen)
approach: 滚动数组优化空间，每步可以左移、右移或不动
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def numWays(self, steps, arrLen):
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        max_pos = min(steps // 2 + 1, arrLen)
        dp = [0] * max_pos
        dp[0] = 1
        for _ in range(steps):
            new_dp = [0] * max_pos
            for i in range(max_pos):
                new_dp[i] = dp[i]
                if i > 0: new_dp[i] += dp[i-1]
                if i < max_pos-1: new_dp[i] += dp[i+1]
                new_dp[i] %= MOD
            dp = new_dp
        return dp[0]
